scope: displacement-based Verlet neighbors, contiguous AoS particle/force/work arrays, double-buffered flat histories
validity: all node IDs, ownership and diameters unchanged; every actual pebble displacement <= skin/4; evaluated at pre-force and future snapshots
proof: pair separation shrinks by at most skin/2, less than the full build margin skin; rotation included by actual pebble positions
accuracy: exact physical/state/event CSV bytes against archived optimization03 and forced rebuild; no tolerance relaxation
capacity: 300 bodies / 1024 pebbles unchanged; no scale expansion
measurement: 3 alternating unprofiled runs, one profiled each; rebuild/reuse counts, retained capacities, global C++ new counts in warmed test; capacities are not total RSS
failure: state/history/time atomic; cache may rebuild after failure but must remain conservative
